We're building the platform that modernizes project management, scheduling, and communication for the construction world - an industry that has been underserved by technology for too long. We're early, we're moving fast, and the work you do here will be seen and felt by real users from day one. What does this team do? We're a small, scrappy team building something big. Every engineer here owns meaningful pieces of the product - there's no busywork, no being lost in a giant org. You'll work directly with the founder and have real input on product decisions. We're laying the foundation of a platform that will change how construction gets done. What will you do? As a Co-op Software Developer at Sahova, you'll work across the full mobile stack - building and shipping features that real builders use daily. You'll be involved in everything from architecture decisions to implementation to seeing your work go live. This is a high-ownership role with real responsibility.
